title: 479 Victims of Modern Slavery Rescued in August
subtitle: Inspectors Free Nearly 500 People from Slavery Last Month
excerpt: Inspectors rescued 479 victims of modern slavery in August, as reported by Agência Brasil.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
In August, inspectors concluded the liberation of 479 individuals living in modern slavery. The number, released by Agência Brasil, highlights the scale of the rescue operation carried out by oversight bodies.

Rescue Details

The operation resulted in the liberation of nearly five hundred victims, who were removed from environments where they were subjected to conditions analogous to slavery. The survey indicates the effectiveness of inspections in identifying and dismantling these practices.

Immediate Impact

With the liberation of the 479 individuals, authorities emphasize the need for continued inspections and the work of inspectors to prevent new cases. Oversight remains an essential tool for the protection of human rights.

With information from Agência Brasil.
